summary: 8 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. PII protection holds — CreateDraftSummary exposes ONLY {draft_id, message_id, thread_id}; no body/subject/recipients leak. RFC 5322 MIME built via stdlib EmailMessage + base64 urlsafe encode (lines 40-49). EmailStr validation on every entry of `to` (and cc/bcc); to has min_length=1; subject has max_length=998 (RFC 5322 §2.1.1). in_reply_to_thread_id attached to message.threadId when present.
